```{r create-ds_metaecos_es, eval = FALSE}

# --- CREATED DATASET WITH META-ECOSYSTEM EFFECT SIZES --- #

# Here I want to get the effect size of the meta-ecosystem biomass. 
# I run this code on 2023.11.24. I should redo it as I would like in this case 
# to use the log response ratio, as there is no zero in the total biomass 
# (the lowest biomass in the experiment was 
# `r min(ds_metaecosystems$total_metaecosystem_bioarea_mm2)`. 
# I run this code on 2023.11.24

# Create a function to calculate the effect size of meta-ecosystems.
# I'm creating a function so that I can run this code on another machine.

calculate.effect.sizes.metaecos = function() {
  
  for (metaeco_type in 1:length(treatments_and_controls_metaecos$treatment) {
    
    isolated_type_i = treatments_and_controls_metaecos %>%
            filter(treatment == metaeco_type_i) %>%
            pull(control)
    
    nr_of_sets = combination_sets_isolated_systems %>%
      filter(system_type == isolated_type_i) %>%
      pull(set) %>%
      max()
    
    for (set_i in 1 : nr_of_sets) {
      
      variable_count = 0
      
      for (variable_i in variables_metaecos) {
        
        variable_count = variable_count + 1
        
        for (time_point_i in time_points) {
          
          if(time_point_i == 0) next
          
          #Parameters
          columns_to_group_by = columns_metaecos[(columns_metaecos != "system_nr") & (columns_metaecos != "patches_combined")]
          
          system_nrs_of_set_i = combination_sets_isolated_systems %>%
            filter(system_type %in% isolated_type_i,
                   set == set_i) %>%
            pull(system_nr)
          
          new_dataset = ds_metaecosystems %>%
            filter(system_type == metaeco_type_i | system_nr %in% system_nrs_of_set_i,
                   time_point == time_point_i,
                   !is.na(!!sym(variable_i))) %>%
            group_by_at(all_of(columns_to_group_by)) %>%
            summarise(across(all_of(variable_i),
                             list(mean = mean,
                                  sd = sd)),
                      sample_size = n()) %>%
            rename_with(~ paste0(variable_i, "_sample_size"),
                        matches("sample_size")) %>%
            mutate(!!paste0(variable_i, "_d") := NA,
                   !!paste0(variable_i, "_d_upper") := NA,
                   !!paste0(variable_i, "_d_lower") := NA)
          
          treatment_row = new_dataset %>%
            filter(system_type == metaeco_type_i)
          
          control_row = new_dataset %>%
            filter(system_type == isolated_type_i)
          
          hedges_d = calculate.hedges_d(
            treatment_row[[paste0(variable_i, "_mean")]],
            treatment_row[[paste0(variable_i, "_sd")]],
            treatment_row[[paste0(variable_i, "_sample_size")]],
            control_row[[paste0(variable_i, "_mean")]],
            control_row[[paste0(variable_i, "_sd")]],
            control_row[[paste0(variable_i, "_sample_size")]]
          )
          
          new_row = new_dataset %>%
            filter(system_type == metaeco_type_i) %>%
            mutate(!!paste0(variable_i, "_d") := hedges_d$d,
                   !!paste0(variable_i, "_d_upper") := hedges_d$upper_CI,
                   !!paste0(variable_i, "_d_lower") := hedges_d$lower_CI)
          
          if (!exists("ds_metaecos_es")) {ds_metaecos_es = new_row} else
            {ds_metaecos_es = rbind(ds_metaecos_es, new_row)}
            
        }
      }
    }
  }
  
  ds_metaecos_es %>%
    group_by_at(all_of(columns_to_group_by)) %>%
    summarise(total_metaecosystem_bioarea_mm2_d = mean(total_metaecosystem_bioarea_mm2_d),
              total_metaecosystem_bioarea_mm2_d_upper = mean(total_metaecosystem_bioarea_mm2_d_upper),
              total_metaecosystem_bioarea_mm2_d_lower = mean(total_metaecosystem_bioarea_mm2_d_lower))
  
  return(ds_metaecos_es)
  
}
```

```{r import-ds_metaecos_es}

# --- IMPORT DATASET WITH META-ECOSYSTEM EFFECT SIZES --- #

# Import dataset

ds_metaecos_es = read.csv(file = here("3_results", "calculations", "ds_metaecos_es.csv")) %>%
  
  # Modify dataset
  
  rename(size = patch_size_ml) %>%
  mutate(size = case_when(size == 6.43 ~ "S",
                          size == 9.00 ~ "SM",
                          size == 15.00 ~ "ML",
                          size == 45.00 ~ "L",
                          TRUE ~ NA_character_ ),
         size = factor(size, levels = c("S", "SM", "ML", "L")),
         disturbance_percentage = case_when(grepl("\\(s\\)", system_type) ~ "fixed",
                                  grepl("\\(s\\*d\\)", system_type) ~ "decreasing_with_size",
                                  TRUE ~ NA_character_))
```
